t: What Manufacturing Process Window Database Is All About
title: What Manufacturing Process Window Database Is All About
description: A process window is the validated range of settings producing good output: injection molding's melt temperature, pressure, and cooling time; welding's amps, volts, and travel speed. Windows are found by DOE (design of experiments), proven by capability studies (Cpk ≥ 1.33), and held by SPC. Run outside the window and defects follow. The window is the process's contract. This database is the complete process window: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
definition: Manufacturing Process Window Database: a complete reference database of full process window records.
key_points: What this database holds: full process window records, each with definition, key facts, and a runnable demo program.
